Name: High Systolic Blood Pressure (ANC)
Criteria: SELECT DISTINCT p.patient_id FROM patient p JOIN obs o ON o.person_id = p.patient_id JOIN concept c ON o.concept_id = c.concept_id JOIN encounter anc_e ON o.encounter_id = anc_e.encounter_id JOIN encounter_type anc_et ON anc_e.encounter_type = anc_et.encounter_type_id WHERE c.uuid IN ('${var.concept.national.blood-pressure-systolic.uuid}', '${var.concept.ciel.systolic-blood-pressure.uuid}') AND anc_et.uuid IN ('${var.encountertype.anc-initial.uuid}', '${var.encountertype.anc-followup.uuid}') AND o.value_numeric >= 140 AND o.voided = 0 AND anc_e.voided = 0 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM encounter completed JOIN encounter_type completed_et ON completed.encounter_type = completed_et.encounter_type_id WHERE completed.patient_id = o.person_id AND completed_et.uuid = '${var.encountertype.delivery.uuid}' AND completed.voided = 0 AND completed.encounter_datetime >= anc_e.encounter_datetime) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM obs newer JOIN concept newer_c ON newer.concept_id = newer_c.concept_id JOIN encounter newer_e ON newer.encounter_id = newer_e.encounter_id JOIN encounter_type newer_et ON newer_e.encounter_type = newer_et.encounter_type_id WHERE newer.person_id = o.person_id AND newer_c.uuid IN ('${var.concept.national.blood-pressure-systolic.uuid}', '${var.concept.ciel.systolic-blood-pressure.uuid}') AND newer_et.uuid IN ('${var.encountertype.anc-initial.uuid}', '${var.encountertype.anc-followup.uuid}') AND newer.voided = 0 AND newer_e.voided = 0 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM encounter newer_completed JOIN encounter_type newer_completed_et ON newer_completed.encounter_type = newer_completed_et.encounter_type_id WHERE newer_completed.patient_id = newer.person_id AND newer_completed_et.uuid = '${var.encountertype.delivery.uuid}' AND newer_completed.voided = 0 AND newer_completed.encounter_datetime >= newer_e.encounter_datetime) AND (newer.obs_datetime > o.obs_datetime OR (newer.obs_datetime = o.obs_datetime AND newer.obs_id > o.obs_id)))
Message: High Systolic BP (>=140 mmHg): Evaluate for gestational hypertension / pre-eclampsia

Message: Abnormal Fetal Heart Tone (<110 or >160 bpm): Evaluate for fetal distress
